summary.name: AsmBB
summary.one_liner: AsmBB is a web forum (message board) engine written entirely in assembly language, using FastCGI and an SQLite database.
use_cases: self-host a message board or forum
run a high-traffic online community forum
study a forum engine written in assembly
build a lightweight forum on Linux or Windows
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AsmBB as a web-based message board (forum) engine implemented entirely in assembly language. It uses the FastCGI interface with an SQLite database for storage. The project aims to be fast and light while offering a modern look and feel and features for busy online communities. A demo instance is available at board.asm32.info. Source code is distributed through a Fossil repository, with zip and gz archives also offered from the site. Compiling requires FASM (flatassembler) or Fresh IDE plus the FreshLibDev branch of the Fresh IDE repository, with TargetOS set to Linux or Win32.
notable: Uses FastCGI with an SQLite database
Source distributed via Fossil SCM; licensed EUPL-1.2 per listing
caveats: The author does not plan detailed build instructions due to low interest; compiling is aimed at FASM programmers
Build requires FreshLibDev branch of Fresh IDE and environment variables TargetOS and lib
